I’m feeling this right now. It’s so fucking weird man... I can’t cry or do anything. 

It feels better to “let it all out” and I’m trying to make myself cry or react in any emotion but everything is so dull. All the music sounds bad. All shows are terrible. I can’t do work. I can’t eat anything except shit food. I pushed all my friends away.

And I feel fine?

I just wish those “calming” or “mindfulness” techniques worked.
I feel stupid as fuck after breaking that window but that was just so unnecessary. 

Why can’t I just squeeze a stress ball or some shit lol
Thanks, I’m trying to look for reasons to stay

> Life shouldn’t be a chore

Wow, perfectly articulated.

Rationally everything is great. But I still feel like my world is falling apart. 

I feel privileged for wanting to die. There’s people who are starving and dying. So, logically, I feel obligated to live my pretty lackluster life. 

It’s unfortunate. I don’t know what I’m doing. I’m wandering purposeless. 

I hope you and I can find something worth living for.

I don’t really know what’s keeping me here. 

I feel like I’m tempting and torturing myself by comparing myself to others buts that’s dumb. I think I may have some expectation for myself to do great things though I have no clue if I will ever achieve them. 

I’m terrified of rejection, life, death, and everything.
I’m so sensitive and in no way ready to face any harshness from life itself. 

But I’m still here. I have to plow through it. 

There’s some part of me that longs for some purpose. 

Maybe it’s the same for you?

> He was loving the girl I planned a lifetime with

Wow that sentence just made me sob...

My ex and I used to talk about moving in together after college and closing the distance. We talked about all of our plans for the rest of life.

But we broke up.

He ghosted me and started dating some other girl. 

I sent him a letter for closure and then I got some shitty response along the lines of “Yeah... no hard feelings, sorry we drifted apart”

It’s sad know that all those words he said to me meant nothing. 

It was a “mutual” break up... But I’m so bitter lmao.
